description: Defines the AbstractPlugin class for JSONRPC communication in WPEFramework plugins, including method registration, initialization, and interface mapping.

classes.name: AbstractPlugin
classes.description: A base class for plugins supporting JSONRPC communication, with method registration and interface implementation.

methods.name: getQuirks
methods.description: Returns an empty quirks array in the response.

methods.name: registerMethod
methods.description: Registers a method with the JSONRPC interface and stores its name.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the plugin, returning an empty string on success.
